Package neqsim.thermo.util.derivatives

package neqsim.thermo.util.derivatives
Implicit equilibrium sensitivities and semi-analytical property gradients for thermodynamic calculations.

This package provides classes for computing and storing derivatives of thermodynamic properties with respect to temperature, pressure, and composition. These gradients enable:

  • Gradient-based optimization of process conditions
  • Integration with machine learning frameworks (JAX, PyTorch via custom backward passes)
  • Sensitivity analysis of thermodynamic calculations
  • Physics-informed neural network training

Key Classes:

  • PropertyGradient - Gradients of scalar properties (density, enthalpy, etc.)
  • FlashGradients - Gradients of flash calculation results (K-values, phase fractions)
  • FugacityJacobian - Jacobian matrix of fugacity coefficients

DifferentiableFlash operates on detached current snapshots. It uses one factorized equilibrium Jacobian and local property evaluations rather than differentiating iterative solver history. Composition columns follow normalized additions (z + h e_j)/(1+h), and pressure derivatives are per bar. Batched properties share the local states. The interface requires a smooth supported fluid equilibrium; reactions, ions, liquid-liquid and three-phase splits are not supported. Machine-learning integrations must retain the returned forward-state gradients and handle unsupported states explicitly.
